duplicate_components: Token Systems: core tokens.dart, glow_store_tokens.dart, belleza_luxe_theme.dart, mens_theme.dart, AppTheme
duplicate_models: NVIDIA Embedding Model (1024d) vs Gemini Embedding Model (768d)

breakdown.ARCHITECTURAL: High - Multiple legacy token systems, dual embedding systems
breakdown.AUTHORITY: HIGH - Multiple authority implementations causing fragmentation
breakdown.SECURITY: MEDIUM - Potential vulnerabilities in legacy authentication flows
breakdown.DATA: MEDIUM - Legacy database tables and schema inconsistencies
breakdown.QUALITY: HIGH - Fragmented theme implementation, inconsistent token usage
breakdown.AI: HIGH - Dual embedding systems requiring synchronization
breakdown.UX: MEDIUM - Legacy UI components with inconsistent styling
breakdown.PERFORMANCE: MEDIUM - Legacy background workers with no active usage
breakdown.AI: MEDIUM - Legacy AI wrappers adding complexity without value

no_silent_legacy_rule.description: Mechanism to prevent: introducing new consumers of legacy components, creating duplicates, copying tokens without classification, creating ungoverned variants, and hiding exceptions in code
implementation: All new code must reference canonical components only
Legacy components must be explicitly flagged in registry
New development must use canonical APIs
Exception creation requires formal approval process

retirement_rules.consumer_audit: Verify zero consumers through registry check
retirement_rules.migration_path: Must have validated migration path to canonical component
retirement_rules.data_migration: Legacy data must be preserved or explicitly migrated
retirement_rules.final_validation: Must pass legacy compatibility test suite
retirement_rules.removal: After validation, component can be removed from codebase

final_decision: READY FOR G1-E CONSOLIDATION - Legacy systems are properly classified and governed with clear retirement pathways. Technical debt is categorized and manageable through phased migration.
